help.inventory:
How to use

  • Pick items to change their quantity, swap them for another item, or delete them.
  • Documents and books locked in the quest bag are freed with Release Important Item.

Limits

  • Items carried by mercenaries are left out of quantity changes and deletion.
  • Quantities go from 1 to 999,999,999.

Other notes

  • The game may split one row into several slots by its stack limit.
help.repurchase:
How to use

  • Sell the item to a vendor in the game, save, and open that save.
  • Swap the sold item for the item you want, save, then buy it back in the game.

Limits

  • Only items with a sale record at a vendor can change.

Other notes

  • Buy it back from the vendor it was sold to.
help.equipment:
How to use

  • Pick equipment to change its enchantment level.
  • Open sockets and fit Abyss Gear; choose Clear to remove the gear.

Limits

  • Enchantment goes up to the item's limit in the game data. Equipment with no stored enchantment value cannot change.
  • Sockets open up to the equipment's limit. A slot holding Abyss Gear cannot be locked.

Other notes

  • Mercenary equipment can be edited too.
help.knowledge:
How to use

  • Choose a category on the left to list its entries, subcategories included, on the right.
  • Learn (level 1) or unlearn the selected entries, or change a level. Learn All Knowledge & Apply Maximum Levels covers every entry, whatever the filters show.
  • Right-click a row to copy its key.

Limits

  • A level change applies to one learned entry.

Other notes

  • Learned From is the save's record of how an entry was first learned. Learning an entry here writes the record most players have for it.
  • The game keeps no record for many entries, such as most Territories, the Abyss and the main characters; they show No record.
help.challenges:
How to use

  • Complete only the selected checkpoints, or the selected challenges.
  • Complete All Challenges completes every challenge the list shows.

Limits

  • A challenge that needs a step in the game first, such as using a sealed artifact, is view-only.

Other notes

  • Rewards, knowledge and items are not given or used up.
help.fishing:
How to use

  • Pick a fish to apply its size record, or to learn its knowledge to the last level.

Limits

  • Catch any one fish in the game and save before editing records. One catch is enough for every kind.
  • A fish whose knowledge is not learned needs it before its size can be recorded.

Other notes

  • None.
help.maps:
How to use

  • Pick a category on the left to list its places on the right.
  • Activate selected categories activates every place of the categories picked on the left; Activate selected places only the rows picked on the right.

Limits

  • Nodes, and places whose later levels come from quests, keep their knowledge at level 1.

Other notes

  • A place's knowledge rises to the level at which the game counts it as found. A bell adds its map record and the Bells knowledge.
  • Rewards and items are not given.
help.companions:
How to use

  • Add or remove Grey-0 robots and festival recruits, even on a save that has none yet.
  • A new worker joins at the end of the list, hired at the current game time.

Limits

  • Other mercenaries are view-only.
  • A worker placed at a workplace or out at a camp cannot be removed.

Other notes

  • Pictures appear after syncing game data.
help.pets:
How to use

  • Rename an entry or clear its name to return to the default. Reset All clears every name in the tab, whatever is selected.
  • Move Up and Move Down change the order of pets, special mounts and ships in the game. Name, gear and level move with the entry.

Limits

  • Other categories, such as horses and wagons, keep their order.
  • Characters used for map viewing cannot be edited.

Other notes

  • Only categories in the save get a tab.
help.npc:
How to use

  • Trust is set from 0 to 100 in steps of 5.
  • Bond changes only the selected character's value; it does not lower the others as the game does.

Limits

  • Only NPCs with a stored trust value can be edited.
  • Bond builds after Interact > Seduce. Only a value the game has raised at least once can change, and not below its current value.

Other notes

  • Talk to the NPC once in the game so that quests see the new value.
  • Kliff's romance quests with the four witches move on from the bond. Stages already passed do not go back.
help.skills:
How to use

  • Learn the selected skills, or all of them, by watching. An unlearned skill is learned at level 1 with the record the game writes when you watch it, plus what level 1 grants.

Limits

  • Only skills the game teaches by watching are shown: in combat with monsters and bosses, or at a demonstration in a region.

Other notes

  • A skill already learned another way keeps its level and only gains the watch record.
  • Level investments are left to the game.
help.items_db:
How to use

  • Search items to see their details. Copy Key (button or right-click) copies an item key.

Limits

  • A lookup only; it does not change the save.

Other notes

  • None.
help.backup:
How to use

  • Saving asks whether to back up the current file first.
  • Restoring replaces the save file on disk at once; the current file is backed up first.

Limits

  • Only the 10 newest backups of each save are kept; older ones are deleted. PRISTINE is always kept.
  • Replacing the reference backup overwrites PRISTINE with the file on disk, without unsaved edits.

Other notes

  • PRISTINE is the copy made the first time the editor opened the file, not a new game's first save.

fishing.setup_steps:

2. Reopen that save using Select Slot or Open Custom File.

ui.doctor_loaded: {count} mission records in this save do not follow the game's format. They can crash the game at the title screen. Repair them with File > Save Doctor.
ui.doctor_note: Normal means the save follows every rule this editor knows. It does not promise that the game will load it.
ui.doctor_problem_container: This is not a complete save file, or it could not be read. Restore a backup if one exists.
ui.doctor_problem_integrity: The signature does not match the contents, so the game may refuse this save. Every record still reads, so it can be signed again. A changed value inside a record cannot be detected this way.
ui.doctor_problem_integrity_lost: The signature does not match the contents, and the contents do not read as records. Part of the file is damaged. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_compression: The contents cannot be decompressed. Part of the file is damaged. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_schema: The table describing the save cannot be read. Nothing else can be checked. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_blocks: {count} blocks break the save layout. The original values cannot be worked out from what is left. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_pointers: A record address points at nothing the save describes. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_mission_rows: {count} mission records do not follow the game's format. They can crash the game at the title screen, even in a slot you never load. Their values are intact, so they can be rewritten.
ui.doctor_problem_game_version: This save comes from a newer game than this editor was checked against. A newer SaveUltimate may know more.
ui.doctor_problem_game_version_old: Saves from game version 1.x are not supported, so this editor cannot open it.
ui.doctor_problem_items: The items do not fit the rules this editor knows, so it cannot open this save. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_page: The file structure is fine, but this page could not be read. Sync game data and check again. The save itself may still work in the game.
ui.doctor_problem_enchants: {count} items are enchanted past their limit. If you raised them on purpose, you can leave them.
ui.doctor_problem_sockets: {count} items have more sockets or gems than the game allows. Another editor may have raised them. This editor does not change them here.
ui.doctor_problem_unknown_items: {count} items are missing from the game data this editor has. Sync game data and check again.

help.management:
How to use

  • Pick a shop to change its renown (1–5). The highest renown rises with it.

Limits

  • Only shops opened in the game that already have a renown record can change.

Other notes

  • Progress toward the next level starts over. Customers, sales and reward records stay.
  • Rewards for levels not yet claimed are given by the game.
help.housing:
How to use

  • Inactive plots are activated right away, without their knowledge or the mercenary work.
  • Export a free construction house to a file, and import it into an active plot.

Limits

  • A ready-built house with furniture placed cannot take an import. Recall the furniture in the game first.

Other notes

  • Importing replaces the whole house and switches the plot to free construction. Decorations that stood there do not come back.

help.collection:
How to use

  • Missing items go into the collection one each. The state filter and search narrow the tables; filling a class covers only the items shown.
  • With Also learn their knowledge, the knowledge is learned as when reading the item.

Limits

  • Items kept in another bag, such as quest items, are not added.

Other notes

  • Documents and books go in as no longer important items, as when read and stored in the game. Items an earlier version added that show Collected (important item) are released by filling them.
  • Journey items show their names only once their knowledge is learned.

help.fieldtime:
How to use

  • Enter the day and time to move the clock to; the time it adds shows below.

Limits

  • It never goes back, and at most 100 years ahead.

Other notes

  • Times already stamped in the save (quests, shop settlements, mercenary pay) stay; the game handles the elapsed time when it loads.
  • The game night (21:00-03:00) passes twice as fast as the day. The night span is inferred, so a few minutes may seem to pass as the save loads.
help.maps_environment:
How to use

  • Revealing the map changes only the exploration fog.
  • Activate All adds every map record of a group. The numbers are recorded / total.

Limits

  • Chest contents, resources, recipes and rewards are not given.

Other notes

  • Abyss Nexus points learn their travel knowledge. Abyss Cressets add their map records and complete the challenges paired with them (marked Includes challenges).

help.doctor:
How to use

  • Checks every slot in the save folder, with or without a save open, and again each time this tab opens.
  • Results are grouped by areas named like the menus: File, Structure, Items, Adventure Journal, Maps, NPC and Other. Point at an area to see each check.
  • Repair fixes only the problems you select and makes a backup first.

Limits

  • OK means the save passes every rule this app knows, not that the game will load it.

Other notes

  • Repair also works while the game is running: load that save in the game afterwards, since a save the game makes first overwrites the repair.
  • Repairing important items in the box leaves them as the game does after reading and storing them. Items already locked in the quest bag are released from Items → Inventory with Release Important Item.
